title: Mr Cap's Refurbished GUI
description: This project adds a cool new look to the default minecraft GUI
body:
Welcome to Mr Cap's Refurbished GUI! 

Tired of the same old, dated Minecraft user interface? This resource pack completely revamps and modernizes the in-game menus to give you a much cleaner, smoother, and more cohesive gameplay experience.

Key Features
- Polished Menus: A sleek new look for the main menu, pause screen, and settings.
- Enhanced Inventories: Refurbished designs for the survival inventory, crafting tables, chests, and furnaces.
- Clean HUD: Upgraded hotbar, health, hunger, and armor bars for better visibility during gameplay.
- Vanilla Friendly: Designed to improve the look of the game without losing that classic Minecraft feel.

Compatibility
- Works perfectly with Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1.
- Does not require Optifine or Iris, though it works great alongside them!

If you find any bugs or have suggestions for UI elements you want to see refurbished next, feel free to join the community Discord linked on the side with my Minecraft server and pack areas!!!
